# fptcloud_database_restored_clusters (Data Source)

Lists the clusters that were restored from a FPT Cloud database cluster, including deleted ones (status `deleted`).

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The Id of the source database cluster.

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (List of Object) Restored clusters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) The Id of the source database cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `cluster_name` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `restore_point` (String)
- `status` (String) Status of the restored cluster; `deleted` for one that was deleted.
- `type_db` (String)
- `version` (String)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_database_restored_clusters" "db" {
  cluster_id = "owiiqtii"
}

output "restored" {
  value = [for c in data.fptcloud_database_restored_clusters.db.clusters : "${c.cluster_name} (${c.status})" if c.status != "deleted"]
}
```
